definitions: A 1994 American drama film written and directed by Frank Darabont, based on the 1982 Stephen King novella Rita Hayworth and the Shawshank Redemption.
The act of being freed or escaping from a difficult or restrictive situation, often with a sense of justice or vindication, as depicted in the film.
examples: Many consider The Shawshank Redemption to be one of the greatest films ever made.
The ending of The Shawshank Redemption is incredibly satisfying.
He felt a sense of Shawshank Redemption after finally leaving his oppressive job.
